title: Evaluation of the intrinsic proper mate
statement: For arbitrary commutative B and every proper/open square with quasi-compact open k,i, the tower gamma and the single-level module gamma [def-cbc-single-proper-open-arrows, def-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-arrows] satisfy the proper-mate evaluation square. On M at level n, evalJ_i at R_r M followed by moduleJ_i(evalR_r at M) and singleGamma at ev_V M equals ev_T(gamma_M) followed by evalR_p at J_k M and moduleR_p(evalJ_k at M). These are the specified evaluation comparisons [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations, def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension]; no finite origin is assumed.

source.place: Tag 07A7, adjunction exchange and mate calculus; strict-tower evaluation refinement of more-etale.tex Tag 0F7B.

proof.text: Apply Adjunction.coefficient_exchange_of_counit with the proper tower adjunctions and proper module-derived adjunctions, vertical comparisons evalG, horizontal comparisons evalJ, and push comparisons evalR. The alpha cube is alpha_single_evaluation. The two gamma counit equations and the two evalR counit equations are exactly mateEquiv_counit because all four arrows are the specified mates. The generic coefficient exchange theorem returns the required equality.

theorem gamma_single_evaluation (B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing B]
    {V W S T : Scheme.{u}} (k : V ⟶ W) (r : V ⟶ S) (p : W ⟶ T) (i : S ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i]
    [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (M : Derived B V) (n : ℕ) :
    (evalJ B i n).hom.app ((R B r).obj M) ≫
        (moduleJ B i).mapDerivedCategory.map ((evalR B r n).app M) ≫
        (singleGamma B k r p i h).app ((ev B V n).obj M) =
      (ev B T n).map ((gamma B k r p i h).app M) ≫
        (evalR B p n).app ((J B k).obj M) ≫
        (moduleDirectImage B p).rightDerivedFunctor.map ((evalJ B k n).hom.app M)
